children: is biased to test support at $99.23 per barrel after failing to break resistance at $102.54.
The failure suggests the completion of wave c, the third wave of a bounce from $96.55. The bounce has formed a wedge.
The metal's failure to climb above the pattern's upper trendline increases the chance of a drop toward the lower trendline support around $97.97.
A break above $102.54 may lead to a gain into the $104.02-$105.85 range. On the daily chart, the market looks neutral in a narrow range of $98 to $102.67.
A surge above the range would indicate an extension of the uptrend toward $105.88-$110.24 range, while a break below $98 could trigger a fall into the zone of $90.43-$94.21.
